title: Finitely many n-covectors separate n-vectors
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there are N ∈ ℕ and n-covectors b_1, …, b_N ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n, i.e. continuous alternating n-linear maps (ℝ^P)ⁿ → ℝ, with the following property. Every n-vector w ∈ NVector (Eucl P) n (a continuous linear functional on Covector (Eucl P) n) with w(b_i) = 0 for all i is the zero functional.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ (N : ℕ) (b : Fin N → Covector (Eucl P) n), ∀ w : NVector (Eucl P) n, (∀ i, w (b i) = 0) → w = 0
